notes.title: Chapter 3 : Graduation !!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=btKll31ExX4;full][/previewyoutube]

It has been a long time since our last release. Due to the pandemic and many other unpredictable things that happened, we had no choice but to pause the development. However, we never give up or stop developing on DeLight. No matter what, we promise to update all 5 chapters and finish Sammy's journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/b04d7da5d54a23cdbabf7cc5b9d5f8bc99c3c991.png

In chapter 3, it comes with 5 different endings. The ending is based on your choices, so please choose carefully. As Sammy is getting familiar with her blindness, she also starts to run faster now in chapter 3.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/c581caf20972e5a2610f8f731b3e761bb80cfa05.jpg

And what else have we added ...? We will let you explore them yourself 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/bf4a8fb6bdc7aa6a9da402555d67b7259325ffb6.png


We have also updated our new OST for chapter 3. There are 16 new tracks for chapter 3, go check them out in our OST album. DeLight: OST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/e54faa8a4e6f1925159aed0d25657bfe8eadcc8e.png


We would like you to know that we have always read your feedbacks in the comment section. So, you will see some changes that we took from your feedbacks. As we are working on chapter 4 now, please enjoy chapter 3. Thank you for your patience 🙂 

Join our discord channel to give your feedback : DeLight Discord Channel
